compatibility_disposition.gate_0_evidence_policy: Every row requires exact source identity/span, effect class or explicit excluded ambiguity, safe behavior and disposition, target phase, unique planned test identity, errata disposition, and reconciled counts. Deferred/EXCLUDE rows require static source and negative-scope evidence, not executable fixtures, semantic oracles, or results.
